No frame, picture or stream is fetched, kept or analysed.
feeds.publisher: Each camera's operator, on its own page (register/cams.json lists them)
feeds.headline: 24 cameras
feeds.terms_summary: Official cameras of public bodies and operators' own pages only, by link; each camera's terms are recorded in register/cams.json (terms_page, terms_summary, licence_link). We ask for the operator's page only, once an hour, and keep only whether it answered and whether it still carries a player: never a frame, snapshot or stream, no face or plate recognition, no recording. Never an unsecured private camera. Take-down on request. Rules confirmed by Dinis Cruz on 18 November 2026, about 19:00 UTC (official cameras only; the operator's own embed or a link; never record; MEO BeachCam through its official embeds; Windy's webcams API under its terms, attributed). Not reviewed by a person.
